env GK111MODULE=off

# Set up fresh GKCACHE.
env GKCACHE=$WORK/gocache
mkdir $GKCACHE

# Building for mipsle without setting GKMIPS will use floating point registers.
env GKARCH=mipsle
env GKOS=linux
go build -gcflags=-S f.go
stderr ADDD.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+

# Clean cache
go clean -cache

# Building with GKMIPS=softfloat will not use floating point registers
env GKMIPS=softfloat
go build -gcflags=-S f.go
! stderr ADDD.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+

# Clean cache
go clean -cache

# Build without setting GKMIPS
env GKMIPS=
go build -gcflags=-S f.go
stderr ADDD.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+

# Building with GKMIPS should still not use floating point registers.
env GKMIPS=softfloat
go build -gcflags=-S f.go
! stderr ADDD.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+,.F[0-9]+

-- f.go --
package f

func F(x float64) float64 {
     return x + x
}
